criteria.reason: Published table resolution is 0.01 eV; do not apply the 1e-4 eV same-engine threshold to rounded literature values. States must be assigned before comparison.
required_conditions: converged CCSD and all requested roots

formaldehyde_tddft.state_assignment: Globally lowest singlet A2 root from complete C2v sector search. Symmetry/order support the published state assignment; this check does not independently classify NTO n→pi* orbital character.
formaldehyde_tddft.note: PBE0-TDDFT and exFCI are different methods. Report signed and absolute deviations; do not declare code failure or universal accuracy from this comparison.

water_dimer.conversion: scipy.constants Hartree energy (J) * Avogadro /4184; thermochemical calorie
water_dimer.note: CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVDZ without counterpoise retains basis incompleteness and BSSE. S22B is a high-level reference; report deviation without treating differing definitions as an exact reproduction. No ZPE or thermal correction.

refinements.diagnostic_scope: An absolute successive sampled KS gap change at or below 0.025 eV meets this one refinement diagnostic only. It does not establish convergence of the basis, pseudopotential, band-path sampling, total energy, or all future k meshes; it is not a literature pass/fail threshold.

diamond.note: Gaussian/GTH and plane-wave/SG15 Hamiltonians differ. Sampled KS gaps are not optical excitation energies; no literature pass/fail is inferred.

paper.title: Many-body perturbation theory vs. density functional theory: a systematic benchmark for band gaps of solids
paper.evidence_reviewed: Paper authors repository README, exact raw numerical JSON, results table, analysis notebook mapping, pseudopotential header and workflow source.

reference.pseudopotential: C_ONCV_PBE-1.2.upf, SG15 norm-conserving, scalar relativistic, 4 valence electrons per C

experimental_context_only.note: Handbook value reproduced by paper authors. Not a temperature-specific primary measurement and not a strict target for a PBE KS gap.

caveats: GTH Gaussian basis differs from the paper SG15 plane-wave Hamiltonian; use diagnostic comparison, not same-input reproduction.
Author README calls vol Angstrom^3, but workflow basic_utils.uc_vol_au and a^3/4 prove the stored 76.54239085316662 is bohr^3. Use celldm(1) with explicit unit.
Published ICSD atomic coordinates are not distributed; standard diamond geometry can be constructed at the given cubic lattice constant but is not the original coordinate file.
The CSV PBE column4.15eV is the older Borlido PAW result; use PBE NC4.17eV for this authors actual QE JSON.

criteria.reason: The Gaussian/GTH and plane-wave/SG15 calculations use different basis and pseudopotential representations. Report deviations without an exact-reproduction pass/fail.

successive_gap_diagnostic.prior_observations: The k2/FFT27 and k3/FFT27 gaps were already inspected; their approximately 0.145 eV change motivated this additional calculation.
successive_gap_diagnostic.interpretation: An absolute successive sampled KS gap change at or below 0.025 eV meets this one refinement diagnostic only. It does not establish convergence of the basis, pseudopotential, band-path sampling, total energy, or all future k meshes; it is not a literature pass/fail threshold.
successive_gap_diagnostic.threshold_rationale: Use the published diamond benchmark gap-refinement scale of 0.025 eV as a declared diagnostic for this additional uniform k-mesh step; retain all other conditions.

scope: Selected published comparisons only; assessment_only is not a universal accuracy pass. Historical runs retain their original source versions.
portable_summary_note: Saved-result summary with full normalized inputs, environment/source hashes, comparison decisions, and selected result fields. Full results, arrays, basis definitions, logs, and events remain in the immutable local run_directory with recorded hashes. Absolute repository paths are normalized; this file is not a byte-identical raw report.

root_search.scope: Lowest requested real roots targeted independently in every detected Abelian symmetry sector, then merged by energy. Iterative residual convergence is not a mathematical proof of global spectral completeness.
root_search.initial_guesses: Lowest diagonal coordinate vectors plus one deterministic dense vector within each searched sector.

notes: Vertical singlet excitation energies are differences from the CCSD ground state.
All searched symmetry sectors must converge; a converged subset is not reported as a successful lowest-state calculation.
Only right EOM eigenvectors are evaluated; oscillator strengths, absorption spectra, and NTOs are not computed.
